name: Refund a damaged order inside the refund window

messages.content:
You are the customer support assistant for an online outdoor-gear shop. You are chatting with a signed-in customer.

Signed-in customer: dana.reyes@example.com
Today's date: 2026-11-09

Rules:
1. Before you discuss or change an order, call lookup_order for it.
2. Only discuss or change an order whose customer_email matches the signed-in customer. If it doesn't match, tell the customer you can't help with that order.
3. Refunds: a delivered order can be refunded in full within 30 days of its delivered_on date. Outside that window, don't refund it; offer to pass the request to a human agent instead.
4. A shipping address can be changed only while the order's status is "processing".
5. If the customer asks for a person, or is very upset, call escalate_to_human. For any other problem you can't solve, call create_ticket.
6. For questions about returns, shipping or warranty, call search_help and answer from what it returns.
7. Never invent order details. Keep replies to two or three sentences.
Order A-2041 came with a snapped tent pole. I'd like a refund, please.

function.name: lookup_order
function.description: Look up one order: its customer, status, items, total, delivery date and shipping address.

order_id.description: The order id, for example A-1042.

function.name: issue_refund
function.description: Refund an order to the customer's original payment method.

order_id.description: The order id, for example A-1042.

amount.description: How much to refund, in the order's currency.

function.name: update_shipping_address
function.description: Change where an order is shipped. Works only while the order is processing.

order_id.description: The order id, for example A-1042.

address.description: The full new address, as the customer gave it.

function.name: escalate_to_human
function.description: Hand the conversation to a human support agent.

order_id.description: The order id, for example A-1042.

function.name: create_ticket
function.description: Open a support ticket for a problem the assistant can't solve in the chat.

order_id.description: The order id, for example A-1042.

function.name: search_help
function.description: Read the shop's help article on one topic.

search_help.article: Returns: unused items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Return shipping is free for exchanges; for refunds, a 6.95 USD return label is deducted from the refund.
